title: The Consensus Clip
description: Bittensor's Yuma Consensus scores a miner by the stake-weighted median of validator weights, then clips everything above it. Validators sit on a cumulative-stake axis; the consensus line is read at the κ=50% mark. Push a colluding bloc past 50% and watch the pump go from clipped to unstoppable.
controls: drag: honest assessment of the miner
tap a column / ← → to inspect a validator
